name: Krummhörn (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, blue and black, the blue stripe bearing white wavy lines, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Krummhörn (a yellow harpy and a red lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Krummhörn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: wavy lines on the blue stripe
